messages:
Alice: heads-up — we just started seeing a cluster of 502/504s hitting the hosted inference API since the canary rollout at ~10:40 UTC. Customers A and B reported errors.
Raj: okay which canary? release id?
Alice: inference-canary-v14 rolled from 30% -> 60% at 10:40 (deploy event from deploybot). latency also up to 2.5s for small requests.
DeployBot: [deploy] inference-canary-v14 rollout 30% -> 60% triggered by @Marta at 2026-03-16T10:40:12Z (id: dpl-2091).
Marta: I flipped the new routing flag to enable kernel X for quantized models — thought it was safe for low-traffic canary.
Keiko: customer support wired a repro curl, pasted below. Getting 502 consistently.
SupportOps: "curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":8}'" -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Raj: can we get upstream logs from model-serving pods? I want to see if gateway timed out or upstream returned error.
Alice: attaching snippet from gateway logs: 
```
[10:41:03Z] proxy: upstream error: grpc status = Unavailable, desc = "timeout awaiting headers"\n[10:41:04Z] proxy: returned 502 to client, route=customer-api, backend=model-pool-quant1, req_id=abcd-1234\n[10:41:05Z] runtime: worker exeption: KVCache miss + blocked on load shard 3 > 1200ms\n```
Marta: looks like the new kernel path increases cold-start load on the KV cache shards. When traffic scaled, we flooded a few shards and requests timed out.
Keiko: any auth errors in there? customer mentioned intermittent 401s earlier.
Alice: seen a couple 401s around 10:38 but those correlate with a separate token rotation; not the big spike. The 502 wave aligns with flag flip.
SupportOps: customers are getting charged for failed attempts — billing wants a quick scope. Which requests to credit?
Raj: prioritize remediation first. Rollback the routing flag to previous kernel ASAP; that should reduce shard pressure.
Marta: rolling flag back now -> patching config in orch: 
```
orchctl feature unset routing.kernel_x --env=prod --selector=canary:inference-canary-v14
```
DeployBot: feature unset accepted, starting rollout revert across canary targets.
Alice: I'm scaling up model-pool-quant1 by +2 replicas to soak transient queue while rollback propagates (kubectl apply).
Keiko: can we also set a short-term shedder to reject >100ms external requests to avoid billing storm?
Raj: yes add a gate on the gateway: 
```
proxyctl rate-limit --route customer-api --max-inflight 200 --shed=true
```
SupportOps: telling affected customers we'll credit failures and follow up with exact tokens. Getting lists now.
Marta: rollback flag reverted at 10:47; deploybot shows propagation done by 10:50.
DeployBot: rollout revert complete for inference-canary-v14 at 2026-03-16T10:50:21Z (dpl-2091).
Alice: watch: 502s dropping — metrics show 90% reduction over last 2m. Latency back to baseline ~120ms.
Keiko: good, keep an eye on billing spike. SupportOps, coordinate credits for requests between 10:40-10:52 UTC.
SupportOps: will compile list and open a billing batch ticket.
Raj: follow-ups: (1) add KV cache circuit-breaker on new kernel path, (2) run load tests for kernel X with cold KV load, (3) add better telemetry for shard wait times.
Marta: ack. I'll open a postmortem and include repro steps + load test plan.
Alice: thanks team. Closing incident thread once postmortem link is up. :thumbsup:
